name: linux-kernel-analysis
description: Source-grounded workflows for multi-perspective analysis of Linux kernel modules, drivers, and subsystems.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Linux kernel code with specialized methods.
interface.longDescription: A family of source-grounded workflows for analyzing Linux kernel contracts, object lifetimes, state and path selection, execution-context handoffs, concurrency, resource flow, failure recovery, and performance, with explicit source-version, architecture, and platform boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this Linux kernel subsystem from source.
Trace the execution-context handoffs in this driver.
Build a validation plan for these kernel claims.
